description: Dreneringslinjer is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kartverket. «Dreneringslinjer» er et kart for overvann som viser: 1. Hvor i terrenget det dannes nye dreneringslinjer. 2. Forsenkninger i terrenget der vann samler seg opp. Coverage: Kartverket. The publisher named on the listing is Kartverket. Its keywords include Samfunnssikkerhet, Regional, Innlandet fylke. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GDB, TXT. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
